encoding.resize: Lanczos, preserve complete image and aspect ratio
encoding.fallback_policy: Never enlarge the original full-width WebP by re-encoding
encoding.screen_formats: WebP only. Measured on the 10 screens at 400w (P5a): WebP q86 221,202 B at mean error 1.02; AVIF q70 231,545 B at 1.22; AVIF q60 191,949 B at 1.41. AVIF is larger or softer for UI text.
encoding.edge_trim: Screens: smallest inset (max 32px per side) whose outer 8px band matches the next band within 40 levels; derivatives only
